गज १

GAJA I . A powerful monkey King who fought on the side of śrī rāma against rāvaṇa. (Vana Parva, Chapter 283, Verse 3).

गज २

GAJA II . Younger brother of śakuni, the son of subala. He, along with his brother fought in the great war against the pāṇḍavas and got killed by irāvān. (bhīṣma parva, Chapter 90).

गजकर्ण

GAJAKARṆA . A yakṣa in Kubera's assembly. (Sabhā Parva, Chapter 10, Verse 16).

गजशिरस्

GAJAŚIRAS . A warrior of skanda. (śalya Parva, Chapter 45, Verse 60).

गजेन्द्रमोक्षम्

GAJENDRAMOKṢAM . The story about indradyumna, the Pāṇḍyan King being transformed into an elephant due to the curse of agastya and his attaining heaven. (See under indradyumna).
